requirement_vague: Users cannot update another user's todo

implementation.location: PUT /todos/{id} in update_todo; GET /todos/{id} in get_todo
implementation.reasoning: Both update and fetch operations scope the todo lookup by the authenticated user's id. This prevents userB from updating userA's todo and causes PUT /todos/{id} to return 404 when the todo does not belong to the caller; userA can still retrieve their own unchanged todo via GET /todos/{id}.
